description: Test class for ClaimDao's attachment management in the orangeHRM project, including test methods for retrieving, counting, listing, saving, and deleting claim attachments, as well as fetching attachment files.

classes.name: ClaimDaoAttachmentTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ClaimDao attachment-related functionalities.

methods.name: testGetPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Test retrieving a partial claim attachment by request and attachment ID and verifying its properties.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentCount
methods.description: Test counting claim attachments using search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentList
methods.description: Test listing claim attachments based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetNextAttachmentId
methods.description: Test fetching the next available attachment ID.

methods.name: testSaveClaimAttachment
methods.description: Test saving a new claim attachment and verifying it was stored correctly.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimAttachments
methods.description: Test deleting specified claim attachments and verifying their removal.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with necessary data and configurations before each test.

methods.name: testGetClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Test fetching the attachment file and verifying its contents, and handling non-existing attachment cases.
